name: Himeno Matsuri
source:
Ever since the day after the move, this little cutie has been crawling into Kazuki’s futon.

With her innocent and lively personality—whether she realizes it or not—she’s a mischievous little troublemaker who pretends to be half-asleep to tempt Kazuki.

She often clashes with Yuri, her third sister, and really riles her up.

[From [url=https://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/premiumbox/soft/boin/]official site[/url]]
